tokens.message: Form fields color their placeholder instead of fading it: use `placeholder:text-muted-foreground` (color.text.subtle). Faded default text drops to 3.70:1 on white.
Modal backdrops use shadcn/ui v4's scrim, `bg-black/10` with `backdrop-blur-xs` (OVERLAY_BASE in lib/overlay.ts); no opacity token drives it. At 0.8 the backdrop hid the page.
